risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or not functional
risks.proof: Photo of battery health check in BIOS or Windows settings, or a video showing battery runtime under load.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if battery is not working or has low capacity.

risks.risk: Screen may have dead pixels, burn-in, or backlight issues
risks.proof: Photo of screen displaying solid white, black, and color patterns to reveal defects.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if screen has minor to moderate defects.

risks.risk: Internal components (RAM, SSD, CPU) may be faulty or not as advertised
risks.proof: Photo of BIOS screen showing hardware specs, or a video of system running diagnostics.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if components are not fully functional or mismatched with advertised specs.

risks.risk: Laptop may have physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., hinge wear, cracked screen, keyboard issues)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hinges, screen edges, and keyboard keys from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if there is moderate wear or hidden damage.

proof_requests: Photo of BIOS screen showing model and hardware specs.
Photo of screen displaying solid white, black, and color patterns.
Photo of battery health check in Windows or BIOS.
Close-up photos of hinges, screen edges, and keyboard keys.
Video of laptop booting and running for 1 minute to verify functionality.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as HP EliteBook 840 G6 from visible text and seller's claim, but critical functional claims (battery, quality) and hidden risks (screen, internal components, physical damage) cannot be verified from current photos. Proof is needed to price accurately.
